title: Error code
description: Machine-readable error code. Request level (HTTP status): unauthenticated (401), device_revoked (401), forbidden (403), not_found (404), conflict (409, e.g. PIN or tag already taken), validation_failed (422), rate_limited (429); any other client error is bad_request (with its own 4xx status, e.g. 405, 413), any server error server_error (5xx, e.g. 500, 503 during maintenance). Entry level, in the push response's rejected list: chain_gap, chain_fork, bad_hmac.
